mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_CHAT_ATTACHMENT ( ATTACHMENT_SEQ, CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ, ORIGINAL_NAME, STORED_NAME, CONTENT_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, REGDATE ) VALUES ( #{attachmentSeq}, #{chatMessageSeq}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT ATTACHMENT_SEQ AS "attachmentSeq", CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ AS "chatMessageSeq", ORIGINAL_NAME AS "originalName", STORED_NAME AS "storedName", CONTENT_TYPE AS "contentType", FILE_SIZE AS "fileSize" FROM TBL_CHAT_ATTACHMENT WHERE ATTACHMENT_SEQ = #{attachmentSeq}

SELECT ATTACHMENT_SEQ AS "attachmentSeq", CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ AS "chatMessageSeq", ORIGINAL_NAME AS "originalName", STORED_NAME AS "storedName", CONTENT_TYPE AS "contentType", FILE_SIZE AS "fileSize" FROM TBL_CHAT_ATTACHMENT WHERE CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ = #{chatMessageSeq} ORDER BY ATTACHMENT_SEQ ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_CHAT_ATTACHMENT SET ORIGINAL_NAME = #{originalName}, STORED_NAME = #{storedName}, CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType}, FILE_SIZE = #{fileSize} WHERE ATTACHMENT_SEQ = #{attachmentSeq}
